about: The gigantic robot brawler is Mech-ing a super-charged comeback in Override 2: Super Mech League! Fight in Mech Leagues and soar to new heights, aiming to be the best mech pilot.

Pick your playstyle across match types including 1v1, 2v2, free-for-all and several games such as Xenoswarm, King of the Hill and more. Unlock a slew of cosmetics and attachments for your mech of choice in the Garage.
Thank you very much for your support. As of August 2025, online co-operative play has ended, but Override 2 still supports local co-op.
summary: The gigantic robot brawler is Mech-ing a super-charged comeback!
